kernel_profile.name: nd-linear
kernel_profile.reason: Preserve one of the three free Managed Auth connections; plain profile persistence is sufficient for fallback qualification.

qualification: Launch Kernel browser with profile nd-linear and save_changes=true.
User completes Linear login in Live View only if the profile is not already authenticated.
Launch a second fresh browser with the same nd-linear profile.
Run the same probe again; require ok=true without another login.
Only then mark Kernel Linear route AUTH_PERSISTENCE_PASS.
writes: Do not use Kernel for Linear mutations until a separate reversible write/readback qualification is explicitly run.
